terra.problem: Achish is identified as king of Gath, but the reference given does not support that detail. It needs a reference such as 1 Samuel 27:2.
David's work history is called spotless as a fact. The passage reports that Achish found no fault in him.
An adversary is an opponent, not necessarily someone who turns on you. The explanation gives an inaccurate definition.
Saying a messenger would be fine with the commanders invents their reaction.
The song says thousands and tens of thousands; it does not give exact numbers establishing that David's number is ten times Saul's.
The explanation states without qualification that the song makes the commanders nervous and that this is why they bring it up.
The passage does not say David speaks with a straight face.
Achish says to go as soon as it is light, not specifically when the sun comes up.
The passage does not say that David and his men leave after the sun is up. It says they get up early.
The passage says David and his men return to the land of the Philistines; it does not say here that they head to the particular place Achish assigned David.
Bethlehem is identified as David's hometown without a supporting reference outside this passage.
